race.title: Coral 'Daily Rewards Shaker' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: JACK DEMPSEY caught the eye from a long way back when second at Carlisle 3 weeks ago and can go one better. Beat The Retreat also ran well on his comeback so is next best ahead of Athair Mor , who's often thereabouts. JACK DEMPSEY BEAT THE RETREAT (IRE) ATHAIR MOR (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Athair Mor (5/2), Rickety Gate (10/3), Jack Dempsey (4/1), Beat The Retreat (9/2), Largy Meadow (8/1), Kinbara Firstdraft (14/1), Gone With The Tide (20/1), Brewdog (25/1), Dreamings Free (33/1), Boston Queen (66/1), Bray Dale (66/1)
